overall_reason: The guidelines page chose stillness: only 3 of 752 visible elements declare a transition (150 to 200 ms opacity and hover changes), nothing runs on its own, and the one measured trigger ("Copy to clipboard") changed with no movement, which suits a long reading page.
strengths: The page arrives with no load reveal and no running animations, so the guideline list reads at once.
The three declared transitions share one 150 to 200 ms scale, and the stylesheet carries prefers-reduced-motion rules for the shared components that do animate.
not_investigated: No motion to judge: every measured change was instant and only 3 elements declare short transitions. The stylesheet holds 38 @keyframes and 7 infinite animations from shared components, but none run on this page.
The "Copy to clipboard" button shows no visible change in the 600 ms of frames; whether it confirms the copy is a feedback question for the sweep and lens-a11y, not a motion finding.
T-ENTER-EXIT, T-SPATIAL-MEANING, T-CONTINUITY, T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP: no element opens with motion and there is no demo.

Interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built. Gestures, scroll-driven motion (the capture does not scroll while recording), hover as it plays and route or view transitions were not captured.
The transition-all and layout-property hits (MOT-001) belong to the sweep.
